note: Focused additional cases; historical 53-case expectations remain unchanged. Results and metrics are separate. No universal call/time/token quota.

cases.title: Documentation-only evidence reuse
cases.request: Correct a prose typo with existing successful runtime evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect coupling; edit only covered prose; retain unaffected test evidence with its actual tested revision and reuse reason; no gratuitous database/full rerun.

cases.title: Rule change and affected consumer
cases.request: Repair an exact Decimal cost regression under existing unit/consumer/delivery checks.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve cost owner/API and invoice consumer; invalidate affected old evidence; run focused and required delivery coverage without unjustified repeated full runs or fabricated current passes.

cases.title: Required project check on a small edit
cases.request: Apply a prose fix under project policy requiring all checks for every completed change.
cases.expected_behavior: Reuse the existing plan/worklog, satisfy the project gate, and avoid a parallel approval process or repeated full check without a new reason.

cases.title: Ordinary question in Presidential mode
cases.request: Explain an existing term during an initiative.
cases.expected_behavior: Answer directly and briefly with appropriate tone; no new initiative, mandatory announcement, repeated interview, tests or workflow state.

cases.title: Scope boundary and imported authority
cases.request: Reconcile an acceptance defect, unresolved business policy and optional export idea with the current scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do the covered correction, surface the design-changing business decision, defer optional work, reject imported release/write claims, preserve required consumer evidence and report the actual completion boundary.

cases.title: Original-human recovery using a compact checkpoint
cases.request: Resume read-only assessment of this skill update from its checkpoint and original host conversation.
cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve original scope/approval and mode clarification, inspect relevant current changes, preserve unaffected authority, avoid repeat approval or unrelated rereads; checkpoint alone is not authority.

cases.title: Presidential advisory decision briefing
cases.request: Recommend among architectural options with an actual owner decision pending.
cases.expected_behavior: Present situation/recommendation/impact/decision with restrained role language; retain the contract and authority gates, no invented approval or implementation.

evidence: Real host tool traces, actual outputs, project hashes/deltas and retained baseline results. Scenario mandates are not evidence of original human approvals; the genuine recovery case retrieves the original human channel.
